ticket.title: Make calling status and drug order type filters configurable
ticket.text:
Make calling status and drug order type filters configurable

Part 1 — "Calling" status label

When a clinic user clicks Call on a queue entry, the app tells the backend to mark that patient as `"calling"`, so a waiting-room digital sign can display which patient is being called next. The string `"calling"` is currently hardcoded in the frontend.

Deployments that want a different label - "Now serving", a localized term, or whatever their digital signage expects, can't change it. Every other status-related value in the app is configurable; this one was missed.

Part 2 — "Drug Order" filter in the Medications tab

When a clinic user expands a queue entry → Previous visit → Medications, the code filters the patient's orders to show only drug orders. The filter compares the order type's display name against the literal string `"Drug Order"`. This breaks for clinics that have renamed the order type (or run in a non-English locale).

The right way to filter is by the order type's UUID, which is stable across renames and locales.

### Steps to Reproduce

Both parts are configuration / code-quality observations rather than reproducible user-facing bugs. They can be confirmed by code review:

1. Open `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/queue-table/cells/queue-table-action-cell.component.tsx` - note the literal `'calling'` on line 38.
2. Open `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/past-visit/past-visit-details/medications-list.component.tsx` - note the literal `'Drug Order'` filter.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Two new keys added to the app's config schema:
  - A status label (defaulting to `"calling"`) used by the Call action.
  - A drug-order-type identifier used by the Medications filter.
- The Call action reads its value from the config instead of hardcoding `'calling'`.
- The Medications list filters by the configured drug-order-type identifier instead of comparing against the display string `'Drug Order'`.
- Each config key has a clear `_description` explaining what the value represents.
- Default values preserve existing behavior so unmodified deployments are unaffected.
